card.name: Linking words in anesthesia and procedure text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, during, and) or a word start (Pro) right before a procedure or anesthesia term such as caudal, lumbar epidural, PCI or prophylaxis. Also the space between repeated 'Step' numbers.

modes.label: Linking word before epidural terms
modes.description: Of, during or and sitting just before caudal or lumbar epidural or similar procedure words.
modes.example: Unintentional intrathecal injection during the intended performance<< of>> caudal or lumbar epidural

modes.label: Start of a new drug or section
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name or heading such as Prochlorperazine or Prophylaxis, after a sentence ends.
modes.example: Repeat once if necessary.<< Pro>>chlorperazine may be administered either und

modes.label: Space in step lists
modes.description: The blank before a number in a run of repeated Step labels.
modes.example: Step 2 Step 3 Step 4 Step<< >>5 Step 6 Step 7 Step
